The decision, evidence, and re-trigger criteria are recorded in .github/research/supplemental-listings-decision.md, satisfying the conditional AC1.

If re-triggered, the importer belongs lake-side (src/lake/reference/listings_import.py) rather than the harness.data path declared on T136, because listings identity/lifecycle is a lake concern and harness.data.security_master now has a Rust port that must stay in parity
